title: Finished runs still list worktree folders that no longer exist
body: After a run is finished, warden still lists its worktree folder even though the folder is gone. I expected finished runs to not list missing folders.
note: Fixed. warden status shows no worktree once its folder is gone.

thread.text: Which command or screen showed the old worktree folders: warden status, warden status --all, session start, or warden site? Please paste one line it printed.

It was warden status --all. The 2026-10-19 retro says: 'warden status --all still shows a worktree path for every finished run, although those folders are gone.' I have no saved copy of the printed output, so I cannot paste an exact line. The paths come from each run's saved record, e.g. .warden/state/PG-101/run.json has "worktree": ".../warden-playground.worktrees/PG-101", and that folder no longer exists. The 2026-10-18 retro saw the same for PG-101, PG-102, PG-104 and PG-106 but did not name the command.
